bibl.title: Golden boys (POxy. 79.5209).
bibl.note: P. Oxy. LXXIX, 5209. - Argues that a hometown victory in an eiselastic event for one of the athletes, Marcus Aurelius Nicantinoous, would give him a fixed-income pension, in a time when Egypt was experiencing significant financial upheaval.
